g.text: Single RTX 4090 | Qwen2.5-7B | Independent 128-token decode histories | 16K history + 1K new input | 5 repeats

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607286

g.text: Signed differences are summed from step 0: slower steps add delay and faster steps subtract it. Shading = SD of trial cumulative sums, n=5.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607286

g.text: Curves end at the last common full-batch, matched step across both scenarios and all five repeats. Partial-batch tails remain in the derived audit CSV.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607286

g.text: A plateau indicates little net additional delay; it does not prove every subsequent step is unaffected. Later spikes and host/observer stalls are retained.
